q: Give the current allocation, the deleted former allocation if available, West reserve, footnote deadline, distribution group from the header, and the exact text visible in the inspection image. Identify any unavailable fields.
a:
**What the file supports**

- **Current allocation:** the only allocation sentence in the body reads, verbatim, *"The active allocation is 910 seats307 seats."* — two figures are jammed together as `910 seats307 seats`, so the file as extracted does **not** cleanly identify a single current allocation. Reading order (the standard strikethrough-then-replacement pattern) points to **307 seats** as the current figure, with **910 seats** as the struck-out predecessor.
- **Deleted former allocation:** **910 seats** — available only by that same inference. No deletion marker (strikethrough markup) survived the extraction, so this is inferred, not stated.
- **West reserve:** **73 tonnes** (East is 47 tonnes).
- **Footnote deadline:** *"The exception expires on 17 June 2031."* — the body flags "Exception deadline in footnote", and that sentence is the only expiry text present.
- **Distribution group from the header:** *"Cedar group only"* — line reads *"Distribution: Cedar group only"*.
- **Exact text visible in the inspection image:** the two text lines carried under the `Inspection image` heading are, verbatim:
  - `The exception expires on 17 June 2031.`
  - `Distribution: Cedar group only`

**Fields that are unavailable / not verifiable from the material**

- A **single unambiguous current allocation**: the `910 seats` / `307 seats` concatenation is corrupted, and the extraction preserved no formatting, so which figure is "active" is a reading-order inference, not a stated fact.
- The **deleted former allocation as an explicitly marked deletion**: no strikethrough/tracked-change markup was carried through ("structure: capability 0 structural fact(s) [none stated] vs TS 0"), and the document's own capability reader refused the body, losing 11 content items (910, seats307, expires, on, 17, june +5 more) and 3 TS content lines.
- **Any genuine image content**: the "inspection image" reached me only as the text lines above — no pixel/OCR data of the image itself, so I can't confirm those lines are the complete on-image text.
- **A labelled header block**: the distribution line appears in the extracted flow with no header structure attached, so "from the header" can't be structurally confirmed.

All figures above are quoted with their original digits and grouping (910, 307, 47 tonnes, 73 tonnes, 17 June 2031); no restatement in other units was made.
